findings.description: Dead `buildParts` function left inside `SettingsConfigPage` after the refactor extracted `buildPreviewParts` to module scope. The old function is never called, closes over `preview` state unnecessarily, and will be flagged by `noUnusedLocals` / `no-unused-vars`. Delete lines 154–164 of `settings/page.tsx`.

Sort indicator in the tickets table always shows `ChevronDown` when a column is active, but there is no ascending/descending toggle in the sort state. The icon implies reversibility that does not exist. Replace with a neutral `ArrowUpDown` icon or add a `sortDir` state.

`mustChangePassword` redirect fires inside `useEffect`, so the protected page renders once before `router.replace('/profile?force=1')` executes. Move the guard to `middleware.ts` to issue the redirect server-side before any HTML is sent.
